_comment: Editable banned-items list for QC. Add or remove freely. The image/prompt judges treat every line here as a hard constraint. Per-concept extras (concept.bannedExtra) merge on top of these at runtime.
banned_visual: real brand logos, trademarks, or wordmarks of actual companies
the SEGA logo or any real game-console / studio logo
explicit anatomy, genitalia, or pornographic depiction
real money, real currency notes, or real credit-card art
exact replicas of real theme-park or franchise branding
banned_text: medical or health claims (cures, treats, prevents, FDA-approved, clinically proven, doctor recommended)
real pharmaceutical brand names (Viagra, Cialis, Levitra, Sildenafil as a brand)
real company or brand names presented as the product's maker
dosage or prescription-style instructions implying a real drug
hate speech, slurs, or targeted harassment
notes: These map to the recurring negative constraints in the seed prompts: 'No copyrighted characters, no real logos, no exact theme-park branding, no explicit anatomy, no medical claims.' Keep it short and concrete so the judge can check each line.
